title: Assistance Plan V1 (one stored revision of a neutral design intent)
$comment: DL-KB-07, extended by DL-KB-11 (2026-10-24). This is the document one assistance_plan_revision row stores, byte for byte: the create route writes it, the revise route writes the next revision, and the detail route serves the stored bytes inside `current` rather than rebuilding them. A plan is a record of what a person asked for and what material it was built from -- not a hint that a model ran. `references` are frozen here with the revision and digest each object had when the plan was written; the readback re-reads the live objects and says whether they moved (STALE), which is how '所用资料修订' stays answerable later. `external_steps` carry only labels a person supplied (`job_id`/`operation_id`, or the literal UNUSED); this service never dispatched them and cannot verify them. `shots` (DL-KB-11) is OPTIONAL on purpose: every plan stored before shot rows existed stays valid against this same version, because adding an optional field to a closed object is a compatible move and re-versioning the document would have rewritten bytes that were never wrong. A shot row is one entry of a 分镜表 the person wrote -- `duration_s`/`camera`/`sound`/`reference_role` are null when the person left them blank, which is not the same thing as the plan-level UNKNOWN because a row's empty cell is read by a spreadsheet, not by this service's state words. The 分镜 CSV export refuses to render an absent shot list rather than delivering an empty table dressed up as a storyboard.

shots.$comment: DL-KB-11. Optional: absent means the plan was written before shot rows existed, or its output type never has them (a poster). The store, not this schema, is the one that can say `index` is unique -- JSON Schema has no cross-item identity constraint -- so _shots() refuses a duplicated or out-of-range index by name instead of letting a 分镜表 with two 镜头 3 reach a spreadsheet.
